text: {"claims": [{"anchor": "SQLite has three checkpoint subtypes: PASSIVE, FULL and RESTART", "claim_text": "SQLite has three checkpoint subtypes: PASSIVE, FULL and RESTART.", "kind": "direct", "sure": true, "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S1."}, {"anchor": "Every checkpoint started with sqlite3_wal_checkpoint() or by the automatic mechanism is PASSIVE", "claim_text": "Every checkpoint started with sqlite3_wal_checkpoint() or by the automatic mechanism is PASSIVE.", "kind": "direct", "sure": true, "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S3", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S3."}, {"anchor": "calling sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2() always produces a FULL or RESTART checkpoint", "claim_text": "Calling sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2() always produces a FULL or RESTART checkpoint.", "kind": "direct", "sure": false, "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S4 says FULL/RESTART can only be initiated by v2, not that v2 always produces them."}, {"anchor": "A PASSIVE checkpoint is guaranteed to run to completion as long as no other connection is writing", "claim_text": "A PASSIVE checkpoint is guaranteed to run to completion as long as no other connection is writing.", "kind": "logic", "sure": false, "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S2 says PASSIVE might not complete with concurrent readers or writers; claim ignores readers."}, {"anchor": "a checkpoint can only reset the WAL when no other connection is using it", "claim_text": "A checkpoint can only reset the WAL when no other connection is using it.", "kind": "direct", "sure": true, "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "Restatement of P7.S1."}, {"anchor": "a checkpoint will always reset the WAL whenever the WAL is unused", "claim_text": "A checkpoint will always reset the WAL whenever the WAL is unused.", "kind": "logic", "sure": false, "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P7.S1 states only-if, not that unused WAL is sufficient for reset."}, {"anchor": "The automatic checkpoint is implemented on top of sqlite3_wal_hook()", "claim_text": "The automatic checkpoint is implemented on top of sqlite3_wal_hook().", "kind": "direct", "sure": true, "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S6", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "Restatement of P4.S6."}, {"anchor": "runs in the same thread as the COMMIT that pushes the WAL over its size limit", "claim_text": "The automatic checkpoint runs in the same thread as the COMMIT that pushes the WAL over its size limit.", "kind": "direct", "sure": true, "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "Restatement of P3.S1."}, {"anchor": "long-running readers never delay the automatic checkpoint", "claim_text": "Long-running readers never delay the automatic checkpoint.", "kind": "direct", "sure": false, "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "refutes"}, {"sid": "P7.S2", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P2.S0 and P7.S2 say readers can prevent checkpoint progress."}]}
